title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・天雷轟くは

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After witnessing the phenomenal race between Tamamo Cross and the other racers up close, Mejiro Ardan does not falter in the face of their dazzling light, but feels joy instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She realizes that there are many phenomenal racers out there to rival her, and that as long as racing with them pushes her to run with every ounce of her being, her potential for growth will remain limitless.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This epiphany leaves her unable to contain her excitement for our next goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Around this time, Sakura Chiyono O watches the autumn Tenno Sho on TV and sees Mejiro Ardan's growth as a racer with her own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan begins her preparation for the Osaka Hai. She remains entirely oblivious, however, to the shadow now cast over Sakura Chiyono O's face…
